'''2007 Worlds Team Dirk Friedrichs LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Dirk Friedrichs]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Dirk Friedrichs]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused|Theed-L-wehaveaplan.gif|label=We Have A Plan}}
* '''Stage:''' Team
